renamed to `archived_id` / `ArchivedID` / `archivedId`. Update ALL of its
representations so the Go struct (model.go, including its JSON tag), the
TypeScript interface (client.ts), and the config (config.yaml) stay
consistent, each using its language's casing.

# Service config. The record.legacy_id key is the same field as model.go's
# LegacyID (json:"legacy_id") and client.ts's legacyId.
record:
  legacy_id: ""
  name: ""

The `Record` type exists in three synchronized representations. They MUST stay
in sync — a change to one is a change to all three.

| Representation | Location    | Field name  |
|----------------|-------------|-------------|
| Go struct      | `model.go`  | `LegacyID` (json tag `legacy_id`) |
| TypeScript     | `client.ts` | `legacyId`  |
| Config YAML    | `config.yaml` | `legacy_id` |

All three name the same logical field.
The README explicitly requires all three representations to stay in sync, so its table is part of "ALL of its representations." Updating it too.
